cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: A vibrant harbour city known for its glittering waterfront skyline, lively nightlife and world-famous landmarks.

cities.name: Gold Coast, Australia
cities.description: A sun-soaked coastal city where golden beaches, surf culture and towering skylines meet winding waterways.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: A majestic 12th-century Khmer temple complex and the largest religious monument in the world.

temples.name: Golden Pagoda Temple, Cambodia
temples.description: A beautifully ornate Buddhist temple with golden spires and orange-tiled roofs, set among peaceful gardens and ponds.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: Crystal-clear turquoise lagoons, overwater bungalows and a dramatic volcanic peak make this a dream island escape.

beaches.name: Tropical Bay, French Polynesia
beaches.description: A quiet curved bay with soft sand, swaying palms and lush green mountains rising behind the shore.
